notes: The exercise library's equipment is filled in from the reviewed research table: 161 movements that recorded none now carry theirs, including gymnastic rings, trap bar, weighted sled, jump rope, heavy bag, wrist roller, parallettes, hangboard, rice bucket and battle ropes
Some movements that had the wrong gear now carry the right one: a plate-loaded lat pulldown was filed as a cable, ball slams as a Swiss ball, and two incline presses and Weighted Step-ups were wrong
An exercise whose equipment is simply not recorded no longer reads "bodyweight" — it says "equipment not listed", rather than stating a fact the data does not hold
Unlocking a badge now plays a soft two-note chime, once, alongside the celebration that was already there
